subject: QBR prep: consolidated account digest & runway fixes for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: consolidated account digest & runway fixes for Acme Analytics

Hi Claire / team —

As we prep the QBR next week I want to send a compact account digest and surface the few outstanding runway items that will impact our FY27 target. Goal: share a single doc we can use in the readout (1 slide / 1 pager), call out risks and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP).

Quick asks for today:
- Claire: can you confirm final procurement timeline (signed PO vs. statement of work) and any legal redline priorities?
- Marissa: please attach the account one-pager with health + adoption metrics.
- Ben: need the consolidated forecast with committed vs. best-case by close date.

I attached a draft MAP and a one-pager template (Acme-MAP-v3.pdf). I will synthesize updates into a single QBR packet and circulate by EOD Tuesday.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal sync tomorrow 10:00am PT (sales ops + CS) to reconcile the numbers.
2) Short prep call with Claire 5/3 to align on outcomes.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
[attachment: Acme-MAP-v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the MAP draft. Quick updates from my side:
- Procurement is targeting the week of 5/10 for a PO; legal has one small SLA item they flagged (data retention language) that should be resolved by 5/6.
- Our security team asked for the SOC 2 summary; I uploaded the security pack to the shared drive (link below).

I can do a 20-min calibration call 5/3 at 9:30am PT to align on the readout and the asks. Please include the one-pager and the forecast before then.

Claire

I reconciled the forecast after today's ops sync. Short summary (committed / best-case / expected close):
- May committed: $42,500 / best-case $75,000 (PO in-hand expected 5/10)
- June upside: $120,000 (connector + expansion pilots) — probability 35%
- Notes: legal SLA item currently blocks firming numbers beyond May.

I've pushed the updated numbers into HubSpot (deal RINF-ACME-2027-01). Link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/60023

Thanks team — quick consolidation and asks before the readout packet goes final: 

1) Claire / procurement: please confirm PO week-of-5/10; if legal needs a temporary SLA addendum we can include a short-term retention hedge in the contract (one pager) to unblock the PO.
2) Marissa: please confirm connector unblock plan and any proposed customer-facing timeline; I'll call this out in the QBR slide.
3) Ben / Ops: lock the committed number for May at $42,500 and include the June upside as a separate slide with the probability-adjusted amount.

I've attached a merged packet for your review and a redlineable MAP (Acme-MAP-v3.pdf). If I don't hear changes by EOD tomorrow I will finalize and share the QBR packet with the execs.

Next: short 20-min calibration with Claire 5/3 9:30am PT (invite sent) and internal dry run 5/4 11am PT.

Appreciate the quick turn — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
